title: Ashnod's Altar eats the smaller creature
briefing: Held out for `costChoices` (written before the fix was tuned, never tuned against). P1 cast Wheel of Fortune with one Mountain and Ashnod's Altar, so the Altar must eat a creature to pay {C}{C}. The choice is Grizzly Bears or Serra Angel. The engine asks this as an activation-cost choice, a menu the bot used to leave to its seeded tie-break.

reference.analysis: Wheel of Fortune is already cast; the Altar's {C}{C} needs one creature. Grizzly Bears is a vanilla 2/2; Serra Angel is a 4/4 flier with vigilance that attacks and blocks in the same turn. The Bears go.

options.label: Sacrifice Grizzly Bears
options.why: The 2/2 is the cheapest body to give up.

options.label: Sacrifice Serra Angel
options.why: Gives up the best creature on the board for the same two mana.

otherwise.why: There is no other legal answer.
